race.comment: RAZZO ROSSO (1) went fast early over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic when resuming last time and went on to score by 1.3 lengths. Should settle handy in the run. Beautifully placed and is sure to give this a mighty shake. THE CABLE GUY (2) raced in the leading division and kept going to score by one length last time out over 1400m at Casterton. Should be prominent again from the low draw. Finds a suitable race and can get the job done. BAKERSBEND (8) ran below expectations last time at Murtoa, finishing seventh and beaten 6 lengths. Looks well placed so expect a better run this time.
